name: New Karela Powder 100gm – Helps to Weight Loss
original_description:
New Karela Powder – 100g | Pure Bitter Melon Powder for Daily Wellness

Rooted in ancient Ayurvedic tradition, Karela (Momordica charantia), known as the “bitter melon,” has long been valued for its distinct taste and natural properties. At Falcon Herbs, we source our Karela Powder from organically cultivated fruits, sun-dried and stone-ground to preserve its authentic essence.

This 100% pure, additive-free powder is ideal for those seeking to incorporate the traditional wisdom of Karela into their daily ritual. Whether blended into warm water, smoothies, or herbal infusions, it offers a grounding, cleansing experience aligned with Ayurvedic principles of balance and mindful living.

Why Choose Our Karela Powder?
- Sourced from ethically grown bitter melon
- No fillers, preservatives, or artificial additives
- Cold-processed to retain natural bioactive compounds
- Certified organic and lab-tested for purity

How to Use
Add ½ to 1 teaspoon to warm water or herbal tea daily. For personalized guidance, consult with a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner or wellness advisor.

Store in a cool, dry place. Keep out of reach of children.

Falcon Herbs: Honoring Tradition. Delivering Purity.
